episodes.title: Making decisions in Bash (part 1) - HPR2639
episodes.summary: Dave Morriss starts a 3-part series on how Bash evaluates conditions: test, [ ], [[ ]] and the exit-status rules that decide, if, while and &&/||.

episodes.title: Making decisions in Bash (part 2) - HPR2649
episodes.summary: Part 2: comparing strings and numbers in Bash, the pitfalls of unquoted variables in a test, and case statements.

episodes.title: Making decisions in Bash (part 3) - HPR2659
episodes.summary: Part 3: combining conditions, testing files, and the arithmetic ((...)) form for numeric comparisons.
